description: Free full factual report on a Solana token mint (items 1-8), computed on this machine with your own Solana RPC (set A402_CHECK_RPC_URL): authorities, Token-2022 extensions, holder concentration (pools, locks, wallets separated), liquidity lock (Meteora DAMM v2, Raydium CPMM), operator locks (Streamflow), and buys right after trading opened. No payment. Returns facts and evidence addresses only — no judgments, ratings, or investment advice. Errors: rpc_not_configured (no A402_CHECK_RPC_URL; use token_check_summary), mint_not_found, not_a_mint, upstream_unavailable (RPC failed or blocked the calls).
name: token_check
